description: This source file defines a class 'SimpleAzureStorageExceptionInjector' that implements fault injection for Azure Storage exceptions in testing scenarios, along with a custom exception class 'SimpleAzureStorageException' inheriting from RequestFailedException. The file is part of the Orleans.Transactions.TestKit namespace and includes methods to inject exceptions before and after storage operations for testing fault tolerance.

classes.name: SimpleAzureStorageExceptionInjector
classes.description: A fault injector class for simulating Azure Storage exceptions during tests, with methods to inject exceptions before and after store operations.

classes.name: SimpleAzureStorageException
classes.description: A custom exception class representing Azure Storage failures, extending RequestFailedException with various constructors and serialization support.

methods.name: AfterStore
methods.description: Method invoked after a storage operation; throws a simulated storage exception if configured to do so.

methods.name: BeforeStore
methods.description: Method invoked before a storage operation; throws a simulated storage exception if configured to do so.

methods.description: Constructors for creating instances of the custom storage exception, with parameters for message, status, inner exception, and error code.
